content.text:
The failure is caused by the `HealthHandler` function in `router/routes.go`:

```go
func HealthHandler() string { return "wildcard" }
```

It returns `"wildcard"` instead of `"health"`, so the wildcard route handler is effectively shadowing/overriding the dedicated health route's expected response. This is a source-code bug in `router/routes.go`, not an issue with `routes/public.map` (which I did not touch, per your instruction). The test `TestHealthRoute` in `router/routes_test.go` correctly detects this mismatch.
